Noah (oncall): RCA published: https://redwood.internal/rca/3032109876 — short summary + action items below. Please skim and ack if you own something. :eyes:
Ava (ops): TL;DR: routing policy regression caused a small percentage of long-poll requests to hit a legacy model variant with older vocab, producing increased tokenization errors for ~22m. Customer impact isolated; no data leak.
Rahul (eng-sre): Root cause: a canary flag mis-evaluated during a multi-region rollout causing the policy table to reference an outdated model_alias. See doc section 1.3 for timeline.
Noah (oncall): Skim copy for quick visibility:
```
Impact window: 2026-07-11 02:12–02:34 UTC
Affected: long-poll / batch endpoints in eu-north (~2.1% traffic)
Symptom: tokenization errors, 400s, slight increase in retries
Mitigation: forced policy refresh and model pin at 02:27 UTC
Customer notice: draft ready, ops to review
```
Action items (owner — due):
- Rahul: add policy-canary unit test and a synthetic replay to CI — due 2026-07-15.
- Ava: finalize and publish external customer note; include impacted tenants list and remediation steps — due 2026-07-13 09:30 PT.
- Noah: add a short runbook entry for policy-refresh playbook and rollback commands — due 2026-07-14.
- Zoe: coordinate CS outreach for the 3 impacted enterprise accounts — due 2026-07-13 EOD.
- Miles: review prioritization for automated policy-eval safety gates in next infra planning — due 2026-07-16.
PR-Bot: Draft external note queued: https://redwood.internal/drafts/rca-3032109876
Ava (ops): Office hours to triage RCA + action items: 2026-07-13 16:00 PT (calendar: https://calendar.internal/redwood/event/rca-3032109876-review)
Rahul (eng-sre): Mitigation applied: `policy.refresh(region=eu-north)` and `model.pin(alias=stable-v2)` at 2026-07-11 02:27 UTC — deploy-id dpl-11321.
Zoe (support): I'll start outreach to the impacted accounts and paste suggested wording here for ops review.
Miles (cto): Two asks: please ensure CI replay tests are deterministic and link them in the RCA; and include a short executive summary for customer-facing communications.
Noah (oncall): Please react with :white_check_mark: once you've read and accepted any assigned actions. I'll export to the action tracker after office hours.
Rahul (eng-sre): :white_check_mark:
